fixes: Reserve saved-audio retries synchronously, reject overlapping requests and retries from Trash, and preserve edited text while recognition is pending.
Preserve failed, empty and review-needed audio when successful-audio retention is disabled.
Protect active recordings from permanent deletion and roll back only newly created unsaved placeholders or failed imports.
Replace a storage initialization crash with an actionable error and prevent writes to unavailable or unsupported history.
Recover a missing primary history from its backup and preserve damaged history with unique recovery filenames.
Finish an active hold when its shortcut hook stops or is interrupted, and require physical release before another hold can start.
Allow Escape to cancel Getting ready before recording starts.
Keep saved microphone audio flowing after optional preview failure or preview-buffer exhaustion.
Bound recognition waits and prevent cancelled or late framework operations from changing a newer session.
Cancel individual Parakeet waiters and requests, ignore stale request errors, cancel completed request deadlines, and update readiness after helper failure.
Propagate Whisper cancellation to its detached operation and terminate its owned helper process.
Stop capture, flush interrupted audio and cancel recognition promptly when quitting.
Balance retained Core Audio device strings and make audio-file conversion loops cancellable.
Reset detail-view state when changing transcripts and report an empty retry as no words heard rather than successful transcription.

coverage: Control/Fn gestures, chords, quick release, delayed authorization, Escape during startup, hook interruption and disable during hold
Retry reservation, overlap prevention, retention, edited-text isolation, active deletion protection, Trash restrictions and quit during queued retry
Missing-primary backup recovery, atomic history, unavailable storage and byte-preserving unsupported-version handling
First-buffer readiness, startup timeout/cancellation, sealed capture, native tap exception recovery, 121-second preview exhaustion with full saved audio and resampling tail preservation
Shared worker startup, independent cancellation, ignored late errors, matched queued responses, timeout recovery, crash recovery and readiness reset
Uncooperative operation timeout, prompt cancellation and late-completion isolation
UTF-16 selection replacement, changed focus, secure/read-only/control exclusion and single paste dispatch

generatedSpeechFixtures.CaptureTests: passed: Apple recognition, delayed preview, actual hardware format, full saved audio, 16-kHz conversion, first/last words, confidence and microphone discovery
generatedSpeechFixtures.LocalEngineTests: passed: real bundled Parakeet and Whisper recognition with first/last words and matched queued Parakeet responses
generatedSpeechFixtures.LibraryTests: passed: saved-audio recovery, completed recognition, search, favorites, debounced editing, original text, trash/restore and cleanup of temporary test-owned data

limitations: One development Mac and one selected physical microphone were exercised.
Generated speech fixtures establish pipeline behavior, not accuracy for every speaker, language or acoustic environment.
Installed native editor checks supplement focused compatibility tests; they do not establish compatibility with every application or website.
Initial model installation, long recordings, hardware changes and destination-app behavior can affect timing.
A passing audit does not establish that the app is free of every possible bug.
